title: Sky, Sun, Moon, Star, Rain
label: ch:fa-sky-words
canDo: I can name the sky, sun, moon, star, and rain in Persian, and I can say which of those words has no established English cousin.

payoff.summary: The chapter closes on bârân, a word with no English cousin, then runs all five sky words back to back and rebuilds the careful wellbeing question the weather now follows in ordinary small talk.
